backup.exportBody: Everything: settings, workspaces, profiles, assets, animations, finished videos and installed plugins. API keys stay in this computer's credential store.
backup.checksum: Each file is listed with a checksum, so a damaged or changed backup is caught before it is restored.
backup.exportError: Could not export. Check there is free space where you saved it and try again.
backup.importBody: Restoring a backup replaces everything here, plugins included. What it replaces is kept in a folder next to your data.
backup.stagedEarlier: A checked backup is waiting. Restart to restore it, or cancel.

errors.backup_not_arrumo: This file is not an Arrumo backup.
errors.backup_damaged: This backup was changed or damaged after it was made, so it was not restored.
errors.backup_newer: This backup needs a newer version of Arrumo. Update Arrumo, then try again.
errors.backup_import_failed: Could not read the backup. Check there is free space and try again.

backup.unchanged: {file} hasn’t been changed since it was exported.
backup.replaceWarning: Your current workspaces, videos and settings will be replaced. They’re moved to a folder next to your data, but export them first if you might need them here.

runHooks.title: Plugins that run on their own

usage.bannerBody: Generations that use it stop at that step when it runs out.

usage.unknown: Could not read usage ({reason}). Check that the key is allowed to read its account.
usage.beforeGenerating: This video might stop partway if a provider it uses runs out. Top it up or move it down in Settings › Services and keys.
usage.vault: Keys sit in an encrypted vault: agents use them through Arrumo and can never read them.
usage.unknownAgent: Could not read the plan’s usage ({reason}).
